summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules, reporting share repurchases of American depositary shares (ADSs) on May 20-22, 2026. The company repurchased 131,796 ADSs at USD 22.86, 219,629 ADSs at USD 22.75, and 218,613 ADSs at USD 22.85, each representing one Class A ordinary share. These open-market buybacks reduce outstanding share count and return capital to shareholders. The board authorized the repurchases and confirmed compliance with listing rules. The filing is a routine disclosure of ongoing capital return activity via share buybacks, not a tender offer or other corporate event. Watch for continued repurchase pace and impact on share price.
